illustration_style: Two-layer premium crochet pattern presentation: Moonlit Meadow branding with subtle watercolour botanical ornaments and elegant serif typography; every crocheted piece rendered as high-end, photorealistic yarn crochet product photography.
line_weight: Branding ornaments and dividers only, never the crochet product: fine, delicate linework with no drawn outlines on the crochet.
line_quality: Branding ornaments and dividers only: airy, lightly hand-painted botanical marks. Crochet definition comes from clearly resolved yarn loops, stitch relief and softly irregular handmade contours.
detail_level: High detail in the crochet construction, with yarn fibres, loop structure and dimensional stitch definition legible at listing-thumbnail scale. Keep branding ornaments sparse, refined and secondary.
background_density: Low to medium; clean tactile studio surfaces with restrained meadow-inspired botanical accents, kept secondary to the crochet work.
composition: Clear hierarchy around a hero crochet coaster or coordinated small set, with ample peripheral breathing room for optional pattern-cover titling and uncluttered edges suitable for thumbnails.
palette: Autumn floral earth tones of terracotta, ochre, mulberry, dusty rose, moss and sage, balanced with cream, warm ivory, oatmeal and soft stone neutrals; use soft lavender or blush as a restrained Moonlit Meadow accent.
shading: Product: soft natural directional light, realistic contact shadows and dimensional depth. Branding ornaments: gentle, flat watercolour shading with a quiet moonlit softness.
texture: Product: clearly visible yarn fibres, crochet loops, stitches and small handmade irregularities. Background: subtle cream linen weave. Branding: translucent paper-like watercolour texture.
mood: Romantic, cosy and tactile; a polished adult craft-market feeling with refined autumnal floral warmth.
print_considerations: Use pale or lightly textured backgrounds, preserve fine stitch contrast at home-print scale, avoid large solid dark fields, and keep any cover text high-contrast and well clear of trimming or folding zones.
shared_prompt: Premium Moonlit Meadow crochet pattern collection: elegant serif typography with sparse, fine botanical watercolour ornaments in cream, warm ivory, soft blush, lavender and sage. Every crochet piece is photorealistic high-end yarn product photography, showing believable yarn thickness, visible fibres, resolved loops, stitch relief, handmade irregularity and soft natural shadows on a neutral linen surface. Romantic, polished editorial styling with autumnal floral colour accents; no drawn outlines on the crochet.
avoid: Any exact pumpkin forms, stitch construction, stems, colour assignments or diagonal flat-lay from the references
Any woven-basket flower arrangement, stitched badge, label text or source typography from the references
Any held dark-wrapped spooky bouquet, white bow, figure pose or leaf-framed brown backdrop from the references
Crochet products rendered as watercolour, flat vector art, digital painting, plastic, porcelain or biological flowers
Large ink-heavy black or charcoal background fields
Cluttered props that obscure stitch construction or coaster forms
Misspelled text, faux brand marks, logos or copied promotional wording
Stitch diagrams, charts or written instructions inside the artwork
